acceptance.given: A Replay Result has succeeded and is undergoing post-success acceptance evaluation.

oracle.expected: An independent output-verification record is present and bound to the same successful Replay Result.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result without independent output verification.
oracle.observable: The replay receipt's independently evaluated evidence contains an output-verification record linked to the successful result.

acceptance.then: Acceptance proceeds only with the independently verified output evidence.
acceptance.when: During post-success Replay Result evidence evaluation, inspect the independent output-verification binding.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a successful replay receipt with absent, non-independent, or incorrectly bound output-verification evidence.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require successful replay acceptance to retain independently generated output-verification evidence bound to that Replay Result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay receipt fields and add evidence binding compatibly.

slice_hint.state_transition: successful replay without output verification -> acceptance blocked; independently verified output -> eligible for acceptance
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A successful Replay Result is accepted only when independent output verification is present and bound to that result.

acceptance.given: Replay validation is evaluating a replay result whose result-determining inputs may have changed without an explained provenance update.

oracle.expected: Unexplained result-determining input drift marks the replay result stale or causes replay processing to fail closed.
forbidden: Silently accepting the replay result as current after unexplained result-determining input drift.
Returning a valid-looking replay result without marking it stale or failing closed.
oracle.observable: Replay validation produces a stale status or a fail-closed result associated with the detected unexplained input drift.

acceptance.then: The drifted result cannot be accepted as current.
acceptance.when: During replay validation or use, compare the bound result-determining input identities against the current inputs.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute a replay fixture with unexplained result-determining input drift and observe the rejection of a current-looking successful result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Detect unexplained drift in bound result-determining inputs and mark the result stale or fail closed.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Existing replay records remain readable; drift adds a compatible stale or fail-closed outcome.

slice_hint.state_transition: bound inputs current -> replay eligible; unexplained drift detected -> stale or fail-closed
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Replay validation ends stale or fail closed whenever an unexplained result-determining input drift is detected.

acceptance.given: An applicable Consumer requires enable execution.

oracle.expected: Enable is executed through the applicable Consumer's real call surface and the invocation is exposed by execution evidence.
forbidden: Enable is executed only through a simulated or non-real call surface.
oracle.observable: Consumer execution evidence records a successful enable invocation at the real call-surface entrypoint.

acceptance.then: The Consumer has executed enable through its real call surface.
acceptance.when: Exercise the Consumer enable operation and inspect the produced call trace.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute an applicable Consumer case where enable is skipped or routed through a simulated surface and observe the real-call-surface verification failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Execute enable for each applicable Consumer through its real call surface and retain the invocation trace.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing Consumer execution records while adding compatible real-call trace evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Consumer requires enable -> real enable call executes -> enable trace is recorded
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Consumer enable execution completes only after its real call-surface invocation is recorded.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result has succeeded and is undergoing post-success acceptance evaluation.

oracle.expected: An independent Validator Capability verification record is present and bound to the same successful Replay Result.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result without independent Validator Capability verification.
oracle.observable: The replay receipt's independently evaluated evidence contains a Validator Capability verification record whose identity matches the successful result.

acceptance.then: Acceptance proceeds only with independently verified Validator Capability evidence.
acceptance.when: During post-success Replay Result evidence evaluation, inspect the independent Validator Capability verification and binding.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a successful replay receipt whose Validator Capability evidence is absent, non-independent, or bound to a different result identity.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require successful replay acceptance to retain independently generated Validator Capability verification evidence bound to that Replay Result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay receipt fields and capability configuration compatibility.

slice_hint.state_transition: successful replay without Validator Capability verification -> acceptance blocked; independently verified capability -> eligible for acceptance
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A successful Replay Result is accepted only when independent Validator Capability verification is present and bound to that result.
